-- test: health basic check --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} health
-- expect --
COMPONENT
-- expect --
STATUS
-- expect --
diskSpace
-- expect --
livenessState
-- expect --
ping
-- expect --
[overall]
-- expect --
UP


-- test: health wide shows details --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} health -o wide
-- expect:regex --
COMPONENT\s+STATUS\s+DETAILS
-- expect --
diskSpace
-- expect --
"total"


-- test: health check deployment --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --deployment {{deployment}} health
-- expect:regex --
{{pod[0]}}:
-- expect --
COMPONENT
-- expect --
STATUS
-- expect --
[overall]


-- test: health check label selector --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --selector component=backend health
-- expect:regex --
{{pod[0]}}:
-- expect --
COMPONENT
-- expect --
STATUS
-- expect --
[overall]


-- test: health multi-pod validates all responses --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod[0]}} --pod {{pod[1]}} health
-- expect:regex --
{{pod[0]}}:
-- expect --
[overall]
-- expect --
UP
-- expect:regex --
{{pod[1]}}:
-- expect --
[overall]
-- expect --
UP


-- test: health shows groups --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} health
-- expect --
Groups:
-- expect --
liveness


-- test: health group query --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} health liveness
-- expect --
[overall]
-- expect --
UP


-- test: health unknown group names the group --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} health nonexistentgroup
-- expect:error --
no health group or component named "nonexistentgroup"
